baseline.candidate_rule: all measured crossings plus capped inferred or unsupported crossings
baseline.note: 37 of 40 boundary crossings are set from a published traffic count taken on the same road near the crossing; the rest use OpenPlan's screening default for their road class. Traffic crossing the boundary changed from 331,000 to 196,149 vehicles a day (-41%).

source.coverage_statement: Section-level AADT covers Federal-aid highways nationwide. Rural minor collectors and local roads may be represented only in summary data; a missing section value is unknown, not zero traffic. Counts may be three to six years old under FHWA traffic-count cycles.
source.name: FHWA HPMS Spatial All Sections - 2024
